<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom (Init-only L1 core). exploration_margin_sandwich_viable requires initial reserve headroom above exploration plus post-probe lag margins, causal prefix determination of probeTranscript, and recovery growth G_rises once the regime is identified.
- Cascade collapse assumes homogeneous unwarned silent-step headroom below total pool drawdown; blanket_compose_screening requires pairwise blanket isolation (BlanketCouplings) with matching sensory alarm ports.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>

- Empirical identification of physical sensors or cascades satisfying BlanketContractSpec or Cascade.emitAlarm.
